title: Snow/Ice Sanding - Hazardous
description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report hazardous/emergency locations needing sanding during snow and/or icing conditions. **The City does not sand residential streets, only major thoroughfares. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.
